## 📋 Summary

Brief description of the bug.

## 🔁 Steps to Reproduce

1. What command did you run?

Paste the exact message or scenario that caused the issue.  
For example:

```
!remindme 10m Take a break
```

## 🧾 Response (if any)

Paste the reply, error message, or log output (if available).

---

## 💻 Environment

- **Version:** (e.g., v2.1.3)
- **Hosting:** [ ] Self-hosted / [ ] Cloud / [ ] Other: \_\_\_
- **Permissions/roles involved:** (if relevant)

---

## 📷 Screenshots (Optional)

Add a screenshot or screen recording if it helps explain the issue.

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] I’ve checked to make sure this bug hasn’t already been reported.
- [ ] I’ve clearly described how to reproduce it.
- [ ] The issue happens consistently (not just once).
